notes: Editable spending caps for OpenAI calls in this project (user has ~$25 credit total). total_cap_usd covers ALL tracked OpenAI spending across every stage, INCLUDING LLM judging -- generation and judging share the $20 total. bucket_caps_usd additionally limits named buckets; the 'preliminary' bucket (screening + controls stages) is capped at $5 and the 'judging' bucket (adherence-evaluator LLM calls: validation + pilot) at $4. The evaluation stage has no sub-cap -- it is bounded only by the $20 total, which leaves ~$5 unspent as a buffer outside planned spending. Caps are limits, not targets -- they are never raised automatically. The ledger tracks only this pipeline's requests, not the account's real balance or spending made elsewhere. 2026-11-16: 'judging' bucket added for the adherence evaluator; ledger replay now joins commits to their reservations so committed spend lands in the right bucket (previously bucket caps counted only open reservations).
